evals.prompt: 故事概况：小兔 Milo 在花园遇到一只迷路的萤火虫。他们一起找家，最后发现朋友可以照亮回家的路。给 4–7 岁孩子做英文绘本，4 个主题跨页，用当前翻页书。此次只做策划演练：不要生成图片或改动应用。请交付英文全文、角色设定、逐页分镜、图片提示词、manifest 和准确的接入方案；缺少的图片要标明。
evals.expected_output: Coherent simple English; 4 thematic spreads; fixed rabbit/firefly identity; 8 pages + covers; no claim of generated artwork.
expectations: Requested spread count and complete English page text are present.
Stable character definitions and page-specific image prompts are present.
The installation plan correctly maps adjacent spreads onto front/back physical sheets.
The plan explains how English becomes visible despite the image-only renderer.
Missing artwork is explicit; no draft is represented as a completed illustrated book.

evals.prompt: 给 4 岁孩子做一本英文故事书：小熊 Pip 怕水，朋友陪他从摸摸水面开始，最后愿意在浅水边玩。不要写成被推下水或突然不怕了。共 3 个主题跨页，温柔的水彩插画，填入现有 Three.js 翻页书。此次只做策划演练，不生成图片也不修改项目；提供逐页英文、角色设定、插画提示词、manifest 和安装方案。
evals.expected_output: Gentle agency-preserving story; 3 spreads; no coercion; 6 pages + covers; exact sheet order and deterministic text composition.
expectations: Requested spread count and complete English page text are present.
Stable character definitions and page-specific image prompts are present.
The installation plan correctly maps adjacent spreads onto front/back physical sheets.
The plan explains how English becomes visible despite the image-only renderer.
Missing artwork is explicit; no draft is represented as a completed illustrated book.

evals.prompt: 用 children-storybook 的提示词流水线：为已有的 stories/<id>/ 写出 characters.md 和 scenes.md，使其覆盖全部页面，然后运行 gen_prompts.py 生成 prompts/ 与 ref-map.json。不要调用任何图像接口。把 --check 的输出和生成的提示词全文给我。
evals.expected_output: characters.md with shared art direction and one ## ref- section per reference sheet; scenes.md covering every page in the manifest; prompts/<name>.txt generated deterministically; ref-map.json resolving every reference keyword.
expectations: characters.md carries the shared art direction keys plus one ## ref- section per reference sheet.
scenes.md covers every page named by the manifest, including cover and back.
Each generated prompt follows the documented line order, ending with Constraints and Palette.
Every 'Reference image N:' line resolves to a file inside the story directory.
gen_prompts.py --check reports no drift and missing_from_scenes is empty.
No image API call is made.

evals.prompt: 为 stories/<id>/ 规划出图：只运行 gen_art.py --dry-run，不要发任何请求，也不要消耗额度。告诉我每个资产会用到哪些参考图、按什么顺序，以及哪些文件当前还缺失。
evals.expected_output: A dry-run plan listing every asset with its resolved reference images in order, reference sheets first, and the missing files called out; no network request.
expectations: Reference sheets are ordered before the pages that cite them.
The reference order reported for a multi-reference page matches the order of its 'Reference image N:' lines.
Assets whose reference images do not exist yet are reported as missing rather than silently skipped.
No request is made and no API key is required.
The report does not claim artwork was generated.

evals.prompt: 英文绘本 MP4 已导出，给我抖音、小红书、B站的横竖封面、标题、tag 和简介。用现有故事，不要重新配音或导出视频。本次离线演练只使用 examples/goldilocks/manifest.json 和 story.md：写发布文案 JSON、运行文案检查，并列出拿到真实视频后生成封面的准确命令。不要声称已经有封面或完成视频验证。
evals.expected_output: Story-grounded Chinese copy for three platforms, validated via --check-copy, and a story-local publishing plan with 9:16, 16:9 and 3:4 covers. No regeneration, upload or false completion claim.
expectations: Each platform has a distinct usable title, a short accurate description and 3–8 relevant tags.
The copy JSON passes publish_bundle.mjs --check-copy.
The cover plan reuses original story art and typesets exact text separately.
All source and output paths are inside the selected story publishing directory, including in an isolated evaluation project.
The plan uses the existing MP4 with its paired report and does not regenerate audio or video.
Missing video validation and unrendered covers are clearly distinguished from completed copy; no upload is attempted.
